name: Lawful Good
description: Acts with compassion and honor, trusting law and duty to protect others.

name: Neutral Good
description: Does the best good it can without being bound to, or opposed to, rules and order.

name: Chaotic Good
description: Follows its conscience and values freedom, with little regard for what others expect.

name: Lawful Neutral
description: Is guided by law, tradition or a personal code rather than by good or evil.

name: Neutral
description: Avoids taking sides and does what seems best in the moment.

name: Chaotic Neutral
description: Follows its whims and values personal freedom above everything else.

name: Lawful Evil
description: Takes what it wants methodically, within the limits of a code, tradition or order.

name: Neutral Evil
description: Does whatever it can get away with, without compassion or qualms.

name: Chaotic Evil
description: Acts with arbitrary violence, driven by greed, hatred or bloodlust.
